shared_elements: upright slab/stele with a tapering or rounded upper edge
low-relief carving covering one broad face
row of repeated figures across the upper part
vertical elongated forms in the lower field
justification: Both are upright carved slabs whose broad face bears shallow relief organised into an upper row of repeated figures above a lower field of elongated vertical forms, which is about as generic a correspondence as relief steles can have. A shows clearly anthropomorphic figures with heads, arms and offerings plus rows of sign-like glyphs in framed registers, whereas B shows abstract/zoomorphic curved forms and chevron bands with no human faces, offerings or written signs, so no specific motif or relationship is shared.
